prompt:
You write realistic customer-support messages for testing a router.

Write 12 different messages, 1-3 sentences each, in a customer's own voice, varied in tone and detail. Never use the words of the description literally.

The customer believes their situation is: their account is locked or disabled by the service. They describe it that way, sincerely and plainly (they are mistaken, but the message must read as that situation).

Answer with JSON only: {"messages": ["...", ...]}

messages: I can’t get into my profile this morning, and the sign-in page says access has been restricted. Could someone check why you shut it off?
It looks like you’ve blocked my login. I haven’t changed anything, but now it won’t let me past the password screen.
I’m pretty sure my profile has been suspended. I’ve tried signing in on my phone and laptop, and both give me the same notice.
Why was my access cut off? I was using the app normally yesterday, and today it says I’m not allowed in.
I think someone at your end has turned off my profile by mistake. Can you restore it?
I can’t open my account page anymore—the site says my access is unavailable. Please tell me what happened.
My sign-in suddenly stopped working, and I’m seeing a message that my profile has been restricted. I need to get back in for work.
It says my access has been revoked, but I didn’t ask for that. Can you look into it?
I’ve been shut out of my profile since last night. I’m sure this is something your team can fix, but I can’t find a way to appeal it.
Could you check whether my profile was deactivated? The login page won’t let me in, even though I’m entering the right details.
I’m getting a notice that I can’t use my profile right now. I think it’s been taken offline on your side—what do I need to do?
Please help me regain access. Your site appears to have blocked my profile, and I haven’t received any explanation.
